notes.title: Performance Improvements
notes.content: The significant FPS drop caused by XP and money objects has been fixed.

notes.title: Optimization
notes.content:
With the latest update, significant improvements have been made to the game's performance. Some optimizations have been implemented to reduce FPS drops and stuttering, providing a smoother gaming experience. However, this is just an interim optimization, and a major performance update will be introduced in the next big release.

The upcoming major update aims to completely resolve FPS issues, enhance in-game stability, and add new features. Our team is actively working on making the game more fluid and enjoyable based on player feedback. You can contribute to this process by sharing your experiences with performance issues!

Stay tuned for future updates with more innovations and performance improvements! 🚀

notes.title: November 2 Update
notes.content:
1) The speed and power levels of monsters in the early minutes have been reduced.
2) The monsters' push-back functionality has been fixed
3) Some minor issues have been fixed

notes.title: November 1 Update
notes.content: The boss that used to appear at the [b]20th second after starting[/b] the game has been updated to now [b]spawn at the 10-minute mark[/b]. New updates will be coming soon.
